profile.description: Active Payson City Labor Day celebration with a carnival, concerts, races, parade, fireworks and vendors. The existing carnival occupies the available inflatable/amusement footprint.

notes.subject: Carnival occupies all available space
notes.body: Janeen Dean replied Aug. 13, 2026 that Payson was not interested in adding inflatables because Golden Onion Days already has a carnival that takes up all the space. Current city information confirms the Sept. 3-7, 2026 celebration remains active and includes a carnival. This is a structural space/provider conflict, not a lead to re-pitch every year. Only reconsider if the carnival arrangement or event footprint changes.
